newsitem.title: ITALY: RESEARCH ALERT-Telecom Italia rated outperformer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telecom Italia rated outperformer.

text.p: Italian telecoms giant Telecom Italia has been given an "outperform" rating by Morgan Stanley, while Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) is rated "neutral", a research note from the investment house said.
The research note, dated August 5 but made available to the stock market on Thursday, also said the price target for Telecom Italia was 13,000 lire and for TIM 6,000 lire.
Telecom ordinary shares were trading at 11,050 lire, up 0.53 percent on the day by 1340 GMT. TIM shares were at 6,030 lire, down 0.3 percent in a slightly firmer market.
